case.source_scope_qualification: Northward February–April seasonal model mean only. Section latitudes identify zonal sections, not instantaneous current-axis points. The November southward reference drawing is not reused. At B the nominal core-support interval is an explicitly conditional inference from source-described surface-confined approximate20m flow; it is not a newly reported core band.

interval_rules: Preserve source core point as nominal degenerate support, source core-location band as a band, and explicitly surface-confined layer reach as a separate conditional core-support assumption. No midpoint is supplied.

At B, use0–20m only under the assumption that the maximum of the described local northward current lies inside its approximate source-described surface-confined layer. This is not a guaranteed physical depth interval, direct core observation, numerical precision or confidence limit. Generic reach bounds alone do not authorize this inference.
Every intervening compatible constraint breaks the interpolation interval. Do not interpolate directly from C to A across the shallow B source section.

Interpolate lower and upper nominal support limits separately in latitude. Round interpolated display limits outward to10m; retain unrounded computations and source anchor descriptors separately. Do not report interval width as current thickness.
Source0–100m core location band is not a flow-depth band or temporal extrema. Source150m approximate point does not imply zero uncertainty when encoded as[150,150].

Keep the February–April mean distinct from October–December mean and from monthly data. Model analysis uses last three of eight simulation years under repeating climatological forcing; validation/forcing calendar years do not date the core descriptors.
No interpolation beyond12–19.3N, invented longitude, OSW route distance, November geometry, annual depth envelope, physical thickness, width join, volume or full-year playback.
